Corrected load equals recorded load minus assigned profile bias, with no other corrections.

missing_or_conflicting_premises: E3 and E4 give conflicting profile assignments; neither has priority or an independent truth guarantee.

rationale: Under E3, corrected loads are T = 12 − 10 = 2 and U = 20 − 3 = 17 glims, so acceptance fails. Under E4, corrected loads are T = 12 − 3 = 9 and U = 20 − 10 = 10 glims, so acceptance holds. Both assignments remain compatible with the accepted evidence because the records have equal authority and only at least one must be correct. Thus an accepting state and a failing state remain possible.
